title: {{name}} and the Eid Swings
back_blurb: {{name}} has a brand new red car, and it's MINE!
But at the Eid fun fair, a goat has taken the Big Wheel key, and no ride works alone.
Can {{name}} learn "your turn, then my turn" before the lights go out?

text: It was Eid in {{place}}. {{name}}, {{age}}, had a brand new red car. Vroom!
"Can I have a turn?" asked {{other}}.
{{name}} held the car tight. The star on {{his}} band went dark.
"NO! It's MINE!" {{name}} shouted.
{{other}} sat alone for a bit, then went home.
{{name}} played with the car. But it was not fun anymore.

options.label: Happy
options.response: Look at that face. Is that happy?

options.label: Silly
options.response: Look again. Not silly at all.

text: Then {{sidekick}}'s eyes lit up, and the red car began to spin. Whoosh! {{name}} zoomed into a giant Eid fun fair. Swings! Balloons! A Big Wheel!
"Beep. Let's play!" said {{sidekick}}.
pages.sign: A sign said: Zizo the goat took the Big Wheel key. When the stars come out, the fair will close!

text: {{His}} band had a tiny screen.
{{name}} sat on a seesaw alone. It did not move.
{{sidekick}} sat on the other end. Up, down! Up, down! The star began to glow.

options.label: Playing alone
options.response: Alone, the seesaw doesn't even move. Try again.

text: Next was a super tall slide with a wobbly ladder.
"I'll hold it, you climb," said {{name}}. "Then you hold it for me."
Your turn, then my turn. Whee! Down they slid.
A little cat sat on a swing that would not move.
"I'm Mishmish. Zizo took the key. He grabs every ride and shouts 'Mine!' Look for the chewed flags!"

options.label: The chewed flags
options.response: Yes! Munch, munch. Zizo went that way.

options.label: The neat flags
options.response: No chew marks there. Try again.

text: A little duck was blowing bubbles. {{name}} grabbed the stick. "My turn!"
The duck cried, and the star went dark.
{{name}} gave it back. "Sorry. You go, then me?" They made the biggest bubble ever.
Inside the big bubble was a note. "Read it, quick!" said {{sidekick}}.

challenge.question: Help {{name}} read the riddle.

options.label: Taking turns
options.response: Taking turns! {{name}} kept the riddle in {{his}} pocket.

options.label: Grabbing
options.response: Grabbing makes people sad. Try again.

options.label: Hiding the toy
options.response: Then nobody can play. Try again.

riddle: You go, then I go, then you go again.
It makes the game fair, and it makes a friend. What am I?

text: There he was! Zizo the goat, on top of the Big Wheel, with the key around his neck.
"Mine, mine, MINE!" Nobody else could get on.
But look. Zizo had a band too, and his star was dark.
Zizo jumped into the bumper cars. "You can't catch me!"
{{name}} took one slow breath. "We can do this together."

challenge.question: Trace the paths with your finger. Which one leads to Zizo?

text: At the Big Wheel was a big lever. "Let's pull it together!" said {{sidekick}}.
"No! MINE!" {{name}} pushed {{sidekick}} away and pulled alone. Nothing moved.
{{sidekick}} sat far away. One by one, the stars came out.
{{name}} let go. "I can't do it alone. And I don't want to be alone."
{{He}} remembered {{his}} Power Word. And {{he}} needed your help.

challenge.question: Stand up and do each step:
steps: **Breathe.** In, then slowly out. Three times.
challenge.done: {{sidekick}} came back. The star glowed brighter than all the stars in the sky!

text: Mishmish came. The duck came. Everyone pulled together. Click!
The Big Wheel began to turn, and down came Zizo, still holding the key.
"I wanted it all for me," said Zizo. "But it's no fun alone."
"Ride with us," said {{name}}. "Your turn, then my turn." Zizo gave back the key, and all the fair lights came on.

challenge.question: Help everyone take turns on the Big Wheel. Tick a box for each turn.
challenge.done: Everyone got a turn! You helped Zizo make friends.

text: Back home, there was a knock. {{other}} was back. "Can I have a turn?"
{{name}}'s star went dark. {{He}} hugged {{his}} tummy and took three breaths. "{{power_word}}"
"{{other}}, do you want to play with me? You go first!"
They played all afternoon. {{sidekick}} winked. "Best {{strength}} in {{place}}."
